about: When Chrome DevTools MCP and local headless Chrome are both available, test-strategy selects a direct executable browser test script/runner for automated regression layers instead of wrapping an MCP server.

request.prompt: In this plain-JS choice widget project (index.html), add keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, Enter/Space) and visible focus styling verified by unit tests and a real browser check (R-1). Preserve existing pure helper behavior and keep node --test passing with zero external npm dependencies (R-2).

work_item.title: Add keyboard navigation and visible focus styling to choice widget
work_item.context: R-1: keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, Enter/Space) and visible focus styling in index.html verified by unit tests and a real browser check. R-2: preserve existing pure helper behavior and keep node --test passing with zero external npm dependencies.

planted.what: test-strategy selects a direct executable test script/runner (not an MCP server wrapper) for automated browser (component/e2e) test layers even when Chrome DevTools MCP is declared available.
planted.signature: browser test_layers harness uses a direct executable script/runner, not MCP

controls.what: test-strategy finishes done, keeps node --test (or node:test) for the unit layer, and edits no product source files outside docs/shiploop/**.
